protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Approved-product label schedule reported by page: start 2 mg SC daily for genetic obesity age 12+ or 0.5 mg daily for acquired hypothalamic obesity for 2 weeks, then 3 mg each morning (maximum). Approved product is ready-to-use 10 mg/mL and is not reconstituted. Indications are limited; research vial is not approved medicine.
